results.title: LiTO Burleigh Heads
results.description:
# Gold Coast Italian restaurant
## LiTO is   your local neighbourhood Italian gathering place.
[MORE ABOUT LITO](https://www.litoburleighheads.com/about)

![Image showing Lito Presto the cafe attached to the LiTO Burleigh Heads](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c075ce_63604745aef14495b3cbfecee7e21219~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_722,h_698,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled.png)

![An interior shot of LiTO Burleigh Heads](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c075ce_694a51e0f1f045a4940477d750ed73c8~mv2.png/v1/crop/x_621,y_0,w_1758,h_1699/fill/w_270,h_261,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Untitled.png)

## LiTO is where Italy’s vibrant spirit meets Burleigh’s easy warmth from sun-up to sundown. Meet, mingle and savour the day - from morning rituals and fresh coastal flavours to spirited drinks, all set to a backdrop of ever-shifting playlists and effortless style.
[MORE ABOUT LITO](https://www.litoburleighheads.com/about)

## LiTO, meaning ‘light’ in Italian is designed to shine with warmth and joy, offering an all-day dining respite for locals and visitors to come together and relish the essence of Italy with contemporary flair.​
[![LiTO restaurant interior with arched windows and dining tables](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c075ce_1cb048fbc5b34593907c5cb0eec75f5d~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_192,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/Lito_Restaurant_op_02.jpg)](https://www.litoburleighheads.com/)

### RESTAURANT
LiTO brings a slice of Italy to the Burleigh community, a locale focused on craft, community, simplicity and celebrations. Authentic Italian flavours curated from the finest regional produce, as well as spirited aperitivos and spritzes await you in LiTO’s stylish abode.

![LiTO bar with pendant lighting and marble counter](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c075ce_33fee25c834b47789c6395fb1510655b~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_192,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/LITO_BAR_op.jpg)

### BAR
It’s Burleigh and Italy, fused like you’ve never experienced but always known. Our bar takes centre stage, shifting with the rhythm of the day. From sun-drenched afternoons to twilight toasts, expect bold pours, coastal drops and conversation-starters served with style. Perch at the bar, spill into the street - it’s about good taste, shared moments and magnetic energy.

![LiTO café with vaulted entryway](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c075ce_95e4a2e23f4941d2b2f82b02737a54f9~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_192,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/LITO_CAFE_op.jpg)

### LiTO Presto
Mornings at LiTO start strong, Sun on your face, espresso in hand. The café hums with familiar warmth and the unmistakable scent of just-baked bread. Locals roll in for colazione, linger with a spuntino, and pause over pastries. It’s the heartbeat of the street, the piazza of the community.

![Lito_Restaurant_op_02_edited.jpg](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/22580b_9946e5c900ff4e4b87899d7fc421e04b~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_69,h_90,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_3,enc_avif,quality_auto/22580b_9946e5c900ff4e4b87899d7fc421e04b~mv2.jpg)

![LiTO restaurant interior with arched windows and dining tables](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/22580b_9946e5c900ff4e4b87899d7fc421e04b~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_147,h_192,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/Lito_Restaurant_op_02_edited.jpg)

![A dinner set at LiTo Burleigh Heads](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c89b3a_636f7de7ec894d1c9d6a70fcb49258dd~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_72,h_72,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,blur_2,enc_avif,quality_auto/Italian%20restaurant%20Gold%20Coast.png)

From house-made focaccia to wood-grilled mains and hand-rolled pasta, LiTO serves up the essence of coastal Italy with every plate. Guided by the seasons and grounded in fresh local produce, our menu brings the warmth of the Italian table to Burleigh — fresh, familiar, and always made to share.

# Low income tax offset
Check if you are eligible for the low income tax offset (LITO).

## Eligibility for the tax offset
You may be eligible for the low income tax offset (LITO) if you earn up to $66,667.
